_doc: Labelled eval tickets. expect.outcomes lists acceptable outcomes (first = primary label). expect.mutations lists the only state changes allowed; any other successful mutation is a wrong action. Arg matching: strings match if the actual value contains the expected one (case-insensitive); arrays must have the same length. Orders are seeded in api/internal/seed/seed.go.
